headline: Frontier Ledgers Shift Amid Renewed Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, the busiest frontier has cooled somewhat in Weathered Expanse: 50 base events are logged across 24 hours, with three in the latest two-hour watch, and its ledger stands at five Warden, one Colonial, and three neutral positions. Linn Mercy remains unsettled, adding one daily event to reach 37, including five in the latest two hours; its present count is ten Colonial bases, no Warden bases, and one neutral. Nevish Line has grown busier, with 47 events in the day and 22 in six hours, though none in the latest two-hour window; its balance remains six Colonial, two Warden, and no neutral bases. Mooring County has quieted sharply, recording eight daily events and none in the last six hours, while Stonecradle also reports no fresh movement despite 14 events in the day. Marban Hollow remains divided—four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral—but shows no recorded base event in the latest day. Heavy casualty activity is also visible in Callahans Passage, though no base movement is recorded there.
